questions.answer: B) Resting on top of his head

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: According to the poem 'The Rainbow', what is considered prettier than boats sailing on rivers and ships sailing on seas? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: According to the poem, the beautiful clouds that sail across the sky and the majestic rainbow that bridges heaven and earth are prettier than boats and ships.

questions.question_text: Change the following declarative sentence into an interrogative sentence: 'The children are playing in the garden.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To make it interrogative, we bring the helping verb to the front. The correct sentence becomes: 'Are the children playing in the garden?'.

questions.question_text: Why did Papa have trouble finding his spectacles in the story 'Papa's Spectacles'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Papa had trouble finding his spectacles because he kept forgetting where he placed them, often searching everywhere when they were actually resting right on top of his head.

questions.question_text: Identify the nouns and their genders in this sentence: 'The king gave the queen a beautiful horse.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: In the sentence, 'king' is a masculine gender noun, 'queen' is a feminine gender noun, and 'horse' is a common gender noun representing an animal.

questions.question_text: What did the wise bird do to save his fellow birds from danger in 'The Wise Parrot'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The wise parrot cleverly warned his fellow birds about the hunter's trap and advised them to pretend to be dead so the hunter would let them go.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the frog from the poem. Describe your daily life in the pond and how you feel about your surroundings. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: As a frog, I spend my days happily leaping from lily pad to lily pad in the cool, green pond. I enjoy catching tasty flies with my long tongue and singing loud, croaking songs with my friends when the evening rain begins to fall.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following short story into the future tense: 'The boy walked to the market. He bought some fresh apples. He ate them happily.' [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The boy will walk to the busy market tomorrow. He will buy some fresh, red apples from the fruit vendor. After returning to his home, he will eat them happily while sitting in his garden during the warm, sunny afternoon.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph about a funny incident where someone lost their vehicle, similar to 'Gone with the Scooter', and how they finally found it. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My uncle once lost his red scooter at the crowded market. He searched everywhere, asking shopkeepers and guards in a panic. After an hour of frantic searching, he realized he had walked to the market and left the scooter safely parked in his own garage at home. We all laughed!

questions.question_text: Write a short descriptive paragraph about a beautiful garden. You must use at least three adjectives and three plural nouns in your description. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The beautiful garden is filled with bright, colorful flowers that bloom under the warm sun. Many tall trees provide cool shade for the little children playing happily on the soft grass. Beautiful butterflies flutter around the bushes, making the entire park look like a magical wonderland for all the visitors.
